metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2017 · I'm Not a Robot
metas.description: Kim Min Gyu has wealth and success, but lives an isolated life due to his allergy of people. He then meets and falls in love with a girl who is pretending to be a robot for her ex-boyfriend, a genius robots professor.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2018 · Memories of the Alhambra
metas.description: After suffering a setback following a friend's betrayal Yoo Jin Woo travels to Spain on a business. There, he stays at an old hostel owned by a former classical guitarist Jung Hee Joo. The two get entangled in a mysterious incident.
